full_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE high-native-resolution opaque square terrain material tile,1536×1536 requested, for the non-walkable exterior garden verge in a bright living-tree fantasy game. This is a close-up continuous planted ground SURFACE, not a room, sprite sheet, vignette or illustration with a focal center.
Reference image is MATERIAL/PALETTE/BRUSHWORK only: emerald and yellow-green leaves, peach and rose-pink flowers, pale golden-brown living roots, warm sun, premium hand-painted near-isometric2.5D. Do not copy its layout, giant architecture, text or people.
Fill the ENTIRE square edge to edge with a continuous dense, low-growing garden bed: intertwined knotted living roots crossing over deep leafy soil, many small sharply drawn emerald leaves and light yellow-green sprouts, clusters of small five-petal peach-pink flowers. The root tangle and thick planting clearly communicate non-walkable cultivated verge, with no open floor, path or empty clearing anywhere. Plants stay low, knee-high at most. Restrained broad dark-green soil shadows support bright fresh leaves and flowers. Pale roots are organic curved branching wood, not metal railing, rope, spikes or vines containing glowing energy.
The tile is intended to be repeated without directional mismatch along narrow perimeter strips. Make a non-directional natural flowing all-over pattern with consistent density and brightness at all four edges; no large diagonal root crossing abruptly at an edge, no center emblem, no strong center brightening or edge darkening. Keep dominant stems well within the tile and use small leafy texture at edges. Pattern has irregular grouped growth, NOT a grid or evenly repeated flower dots. No deep side faces, horizon, distant view, vertical trees, tall canopy, buildings or cliffs.
True newly painted native fine detail: individual leaf veins, softly beveled root bark, delicate flower centers and layered petals. Matte luminous hand-painted game finish, clean confident edge shapes, no photo noise or plastic gloss. Typical leaf about18–35 native pixels long and small bloom25–40 pixels wide on a1536 canvas, many but not uniformly distributed. Daylight from above with mild upper-left highlights, weak shadows so tile orientation stays unobtrusive. Whole surface is flat enough for topdown texture mapping.
Opaque RGB fullbleed; no transparent background, checkerboard, empty margin, frame or border. No ground paving, walkable gold floor, props, creatures, characters, eyes, faces, rootwell, crystal, water, pot, chest, beacon, text, labels, numbers, symbols, arrows, UI or watermark. One single seamless-looking native garden material texture only.

qa.visual_inspection: Dense opaque flowering/root garden bed, no path/props/lettering or canopy. Broad but shallow root branches with pink blossoms and leaf detail match B05. Tile repetition/seams require actual narrow-strip pilot inspection; not declared seamless.
